notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/fe245532dd48bb8f48e51ef2d1553f0d7bacf31d.png[/img]

We're still working on the rewrite, but have come up with against a wall. For a variety of reasons, some of us would like a new game entirely, much like Joe Papp 2 is just the rewrite of Joe Papp 1, and some of us think the rewrite should still be a patch. 

We are currently debating what the best route is, both financially and creatively. 

We will keep you posted.

notes.title: SCARECROWS OF ILLYRIA update progress update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/8f1fb30c23f3a6ddbbf701c1b714e946f915ca3b.png[/img]
All of the new backgrounds are in for [b]Scarecrows of Illyria[/b], and we're having a new writer's room/production meeting this weekend to discuss tweaks to the current story. We just felt like, as we were getting rid of the AI art, we also could update the narrative as well.

While we do not want to give an actual date for the new version of the game to actually drop, we do want to express that it should be out before the end of the year. There are just a few other projects for 2025 that came up in the meantime.

So the 2025 slate pretty much looks like:
- [b]Game 2025 #1[/b]
- [b]Game 2025 #2[/b] (which might be ready to have a Coming Soon page up by next week, who knows)
- [b]Scarecrows of Illyria rewrite[/b]
- [b]Tentacle Prawn DLC[/b]

notes.title: The FINAL FIVE SHAKESPEARE + DCS update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33017070/a3690f55b8af0f5dccbcfd45c9c724daf41ba655.gif[/img]
The mad quest to make a game for every Shakespeare play is swiftly reaching its promised end, with the first being Army of Tentacles: [b]Assault on Rainbow Unicorn Island[/b]. After that, maybe we can sleep. 

Two are scheduled for the end of 2024, but the majority of work on those will commence after [b]Dinosaur Cousin Squad[/b] has dropped. We don't yet know when that one will have a Store Page up, but we assume within the next few months. Both games were being prepped while Dinosaur Cousin Squad was being worked on, but DCS progress has hit a few fun new snags, so we might be able to finish before proper level clean-up is set to begin in a few months. 

The final two are set for early and late 2025. One is a collaboration, and the other is another new engine, new genre game..... this time: a tRPG deck builder. In layman's terms, a party based tactical RPG with a card system. We've very recently begun pre-production and asset buy on that one. 

Store pages for at least two of the final four adaptations will be popping up after [b]Rainbow Unicorn Island[/b] drops on the 23rd.

notes.title: Army of Tentacles 2 + Tentacle Prawn Update!
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/16ef3a649aaa065e3c7e0b9dae1641b69975471e.jpg[/img]

First off, it's really ridiculous that we finally got out the final [b]Army of Tentacles[/b]. Yes, Unicorns is coming later, and Tentacle Prawn technically counts as a spin-off in the same way that the Mythos games do, but for all mentally stressful purposes, the trilogy is over. 

Yes, that feels weird, considering the series began in 2016 and the recodes are still being worked on. [b]Army 3[/b]'s recode now only has 20 Arguments, and even though we're working on [b]Dinosaur Cousin Squad[/b] exclusively after March ends, not working on any other projects is going to free up time to finish those. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1082690/Army_of_Tentacles_Not_A_Cthulhu_Dating_Sim_2
Next up is [b]Tentacle Prawn[/b], which is a mix of [b]Paper Shakespeare/Army of Tentacles[/b].....

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33017070/1fa80cda64c2e0aead641890ad04cd3023642720.jpg[/img]

Internally, we've been referring to it as Army of Tentacles 4, even though it's... really not an entry in the main arc. It has.... stuff in it, and it really is a true mixture of the two worlds, but it is its own thing entirely. 

It's going to go live early April.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1727790/Tentacle_Prawn_Actually_A_Cthulhu_Dating_Sim
